description: Compare 2 to 4 pitches side by side: ask, stage, sector, region, traction, green flags, score, dimension scores (with an API key) and compact anonymised decisions (investor API keys only, withheld below 5 people). All or nothing: any missing, non-public or opted-out id answers NOT_FOUND for the whole call. Each pitch returned counts 1 against the shared daily pitch allowance (0 if this caller already got it today).
